decisions.rationale: Re-apply the best wmma_tile configuration (vs_default≈0.998) and pair it with pipeline_stages=4 to see if a 4-stage pipeline (3 in-flight prefetch stages) yields meaningful latency hiding beyond depth=2.
Test 4-stage pipeline with the best wmma_tile — deeper pipelining can overcome the higher GMEM latency when the tile is large enough to justify the additional shared memory buffers.
